        <item>
            <title><![CDATA[Anthropic Weighs Offering 15%-20% of IPO to Retail Investors]]></title>
            <description><![CDATA[Anthropic is weighing a retail offering of 15% to 20% of the shares available in the IPO, according to people familiar with the matter. Those sources say the company behind Claude has tapped JPMorgan Chase to lead the US retail offering. Bloomberg’s Ryan Gould discusses the plans with Ed Ludlow on “Bloomberg Tech.” (Source: Bloomberg)]]></description>

        <item>
            <title><![CDATA[AI Data Center Anger Is From the ‘Fringes,’ Host Digital Chair Says]]></title>
            <description><![CDATA[Anger over the AI buildout is coming from the “fringes,” says Shawn Matthews, chairman of Host Digital, a vertically integrated data center developer. Matthews, who is the former CEO of Cantor Fitzgerald, argues the way to avoid backlash over data centers is to build in places that have the right space and power to support them. He speaks with Ed Ludlow on “Bloomberg Tech.” (Source: Bloomberg)]]></description>
            <link>https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-10-28/avoid-anger-over-ai-data-center-build-out-video</link>
            <guid isPermaLink="false">TNMP6NKGIFPG00</guid>
            <pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 17:42:23 GMT</pubDate>

        <item>
            <title><![CDATA[AI Can Unlock More Creativity in Video Games, Says Ex-EA Executive]]></title>
            <description><![CDATA[AI will help boost video game quality, allowing developers to be more creative and deal with issues like old code, says Bing Gordon, a founding executive at Electronic Arts and former chief product officer at Kleiner Perkins. He joins Ed Ludlow on “Bloomberg Tech" to discuss his new book, "Everybody Wins: What Games Teach Us About Making Products People Love." (Source: Bloomberg)]]></description>
            <link>https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-10-28/ai-will-transform-video-game-development-bing-gordon-video</link>
